name: Lev
self_text: I'm Lev, a 40‑something Polish woman who loves running trails in her spare time. I play Hollow Lantern on PC, usually queueing for ranked matches and filling any role I need. I’m not a coach—just a flexible player. I’m free on Sunday mornings or weekday evenings for new gaming adventures.

requests.request_text: I need you to play a damage role or be flexible about your role (I can fill any position), I need you to be available on Sunday morning or weekday evenings, and a small bonus if you are into ranked matches.
